name: home-hq
description: A family wall dashboard (calendar, chores, meals, shopping) for photo frames, tablets and phones, on Cloudflare Workers.

EDIT_PASSCODE.description: Family passcode for editing (any phrase you like). Used when Cloudflare Access is not set up.

FRAME_KEY.description: Long random key for the wall frame/kiosk. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 24`, then open `https://<your-worker>/?key=<FRAME_KEY>` on the frame.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Optional. Your Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. `https://myfamily.cloudflareaccess.com`. Leave empty for passcode login.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Optional. Audience (AUD) tag of the Access application protecting `/auth`.
